fluff.overview:
Every Concordat world maintains infantry formations as the first line of planetary defense, drawn from a population whose fierce independence and hatred of foreign aggression run deep. Motorized platoons provide faster response than foot infantry without the cost of full mechanized transport, riding light vehicles or motorcycles that can cover ground quickly on the road networks connecting Taurian population centers. Their speed makes them well-suited to the wide-area patrol duties that Concordat garrison doctrine demands.

Support troops operate man-portable long-range missile launchers capable of engaging targets at distances well beyond personal weapon range, providing the platoon with indirect fire capability against vehicles and fortified positions.
